transcript: Oh my god, I ain't really Kansas anymore, like it's just so hard. Listen, I know he's cheating and he's lying though, but the real question is my nigga, did you die though? I got shot in the head, but did you die though? My nigga got a nigga in his bed, but did you die though? Girl, you driving too fast, did you die though? Girl, I just bailed this class, did you die though? Next time you're feeling kind of sad and you're doing kind of bad, just sit back and ask, did I die though? No, I didn't.
metadata_caption: mike hanlon @ the population of derry
